# Redress Compliance

> > Independent enterprise software advisory firm specializing in vendor contract negotiation, license optimization, and audit defense across 10+ major platforms including Oracle, Microsoft, SAP, Salesforce, IBM, AWS, Google Cloud, and emerging GenAI technologies.

Redress Compliance advises 500+ clients globally with former vendor executives (Oracle VP, Microsoft insider, IBM auditor) delivering 15-40% cost savings through independent advisory, contract renegotiation, and compliance management. Operating from offices in the US, Ireland, and Dubai, the firm provides both one-off project services and subscription-based advisory across enterprise software, cloud platforms, and AI licensing.

## Core Enterprise Vendor Advisory

- [Oracle Advisory Services](https://redresscompliance.com/oracle-license-consulting-services): Oracle audit defense, license management, ULA certification, and contract negotiation services.
- [Microsoft Advisory Services](https://redresscompliance.com/microsoft-services): Microsoft EA renewals, Azure optimization, audit defense, and enterprise licensing cost reduction.
- [SAP Advisory Services](https://redresscompliance.com/sap-services): SAP license optimization, audit defense, S/4HANA migration planning, and contract negotiation.
- [IBM Advisory Services](https://redresscompliance.com/ibm-license-management-services): IBM licensing assessment, audit defense, ELA renewal, and PVU optimization.
- [Broadcom & VMware Advisory Services](https://redresscompliance.com/broadcom-advisory-services): Broadcom/VMware contract negotiation, audit defense, and bundle right-sizing optimization.

## SaaS & Cloud Platform Advisory

- [Salesforce Advisory Services](https://redresscompliance.com/salesforce-services): Salesforce contract negotiation, SELA review, license optimization, and M&A support.
- [ServiceNow Advisory Services](https://redresscompliance.com/servicenow-services.html): ServiceNow contract negotiation, benchmarking, and license optimization with 15-30% savings.
- [Workday Advisory Services](https://redresscompliance.com/workday-services.html): Workday contract negotiation, renewal benchmarking, and HCM/Finance module optimization.
- [Adobe Licensing Advisory](https://redresscompliance.com/adobe-licensing-advisory.html): Adobe ETLA/VIP negotiation, compliance audit defense, and 20-35% cost reduction strategies.
- [Cisco Contract Negotiation Services](https://redresscompliance.com/cisco-negotiation-services.html): Cisco ELA optimization, Smart Licensing true-up resolution, and contract negotiation.

## Cloud & AI Vendor Advisory

- [AWS Contract Negotiation Service](https://redresscompliance.com/aws-services): AWS EDP negotiation, private pricing agreements, cloud cost optimization, and 15-30% savings.
- [Google Cloud Advisory Services](https://redresscompliance.com/google-services.html): Google Cloud GCP negotiation, Workspace advisory, cost optimization across 200+ engagements.
- [GenAI Contract Negotiation Services](https://redresscompliance.com/genai-negotiation-services): OpenAI, Copilot, Gemini, and Anthropic contract negotiation with 20-40% cost savings.
